notes: Session 2. Closed B5-0627, a one-clause wording fix in AGENT_LOOP.md the human approved, and the smallest task of the session filed anyway because the repo rule is that work is never DONE unless it was OPEN and claimed, and because the defect was worth recording precisely for being small. The STOP clause read 'report the run: iterations, tasks closed, commit hash, and every file deliberately left uncommitted', which is self-contradictory in a single sentence: it demands a commit hash and a list of uncommitted files in the same breath as though a run were expected to commit some things and leave others, and there is no middle case because the loop commits nothing. Verified the underlying claim against CODE before changing the words rather than after, since 'no commit hash can exist' is a claim about code: git commit appears in NEITHER AGENT_LOOP.md step 7 NOR the run-queue.ps1 task template, so the invariant the fix asserts is one the code already had and only the prose contradicted. Changing the wording first and checking the code afterwards would have made the document its own evidence. Census before edit found THIRTY-ONE occurrences of the phrase repo-wide, of which exactly ONE was a live instruction, this clause, while the other thirty were historical close-out reports and ledger rows recording tasks that genuinely did commit and were correct when written; all thirty left untouched, because rewriting a historical report to match present behaviour falsifies the record and a ledger is append-only for a reason. The replacement states the invariant positively and adds the sentence that earns the edit, that a run ending with a dirty tree is a CORRECT run and not a failed one, since without it an agent handed the original wording has two bad options and no good one, fabricating a hash or reporting the run as broken, and both are worse than reporting honestly. Re-read the file from disk after editing rather than trusting the editor: no commit-hash request remains, the no-commit statement is present, the code fence is balanced, the frontmatter still opens on line 1, the em dash is a real U+2014, and no mojibake was written. Hermes test readiness, checked this pass: hermes is installed at AppData/Local/hermes/bin/hermes.exe but has NO bare positional prompt, its positional being a subcommand, so the runner's default invocation would fail; its non-interactive mode is -z/--oneshot, smoke-tested at exit 0 in 12.3s with clean stdout, so the working invocation is -AgentCli hermes -AgentArgs '-z'. Noted and not fixed: -AgentArgs appends its value as a SINGLE array element, so multi-flag strings such as '-z --yolo' would arrive as one malformed argument and a wrapper script would be needed if hermes blocks on tool approvals in one-shot mode. Gates green: compile.bat Build successful, runner exit 0 with no crash. Queue is currently EMPTY, so a hermes test run would report drained until a row is seeded or an owner releases one. Reusable lesson: a small fix can still be worth a full close-out, because the reason to file it is not the size of the diff but that the defect was live, and liveness is the only property that makes prose worth correcting.
